options.description: Optional, set if differs from the checkout directory. [Learn more](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/?Build+Working+Directory).
Specify a path to a C# script file, relative to the checkout directory. [Learn more](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/?csharp+script).

Leave blank to use NuGet.org. To use a [TeamCity NuGet feed](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/using-teamcity-as-nuget-feed.html?using-teamcity-as-nuget-feed), specify the URL from the NuGet feed project settings page. For feeds with authentication, configure the [NuGet Feed Credentials](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/nuget-feed-credentials.html?NuGet+Feed+Credentials) build feature
